title: Agent instructions
summary: Operating rules for agents in this repo: read SPEC, DECISIONS, STATUS first; flag conflicts; freshness, identity, dedupe, secrets, and test rules; code layout.
notes: Manifest-declared DOC (authoritative, manifest_override true). Filename is not hash-named: the classifier had no SHA-256 tool, so the output file is named AGENTS-hashpending.json instead of AGENTS-{8-hex-sha256-of-path}.json. Rename to the hash-based name before synthesis. Content is operational rules rather than requirements, which fits DOC context-only status.
